searches.name: Windows WinGet Configuration File From Remote URL
searches.spl:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly`
  count min(_time) as firstTime
        max(_time) as lastTime

from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where

(Processes.process_name="winget.exe" OR Processes.original_file_name="winget.exe")
Processes.process IN ("*configure*", "*configuration*", "*dsc*")
Processes.process IN ("*http://*", "*https://*")

by Processes.action Processes.dest Processes.original_file_name Processes.parent_process Processes.parent_process_exec
   Processes.parent_process_guid Processes.parent_process_id Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_path
   Processes.process Processes.process_exec Processes.process_guid Processes.process_hash Processes.process_id
   Processes.process_integrity_level Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.user Processes.user_id
   Processes.vendor_product

| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where match(process, "(?i)winget(\.exe)?\"?\s+(configure|configuration|dsc)\s.*https?://")
| eval configuration_action=if(match(process, "(?i)\s(configure|configuration|dsc)\s+(show|view|validate|list|ls|test)\b"), "preview", "apply")
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| `windows_winget_configuration_file_from_remote_url_filter`

searches.name: Windows WinGet Configuration Remoting Server Execution
searches.spl:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly`
  count min(_time) as firstTime
        max(_time) as lastTime

from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where

Processes.process_name="ConfigurationRemotingServer.exe"
Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winget.exe", "WindowsPackageManagerServer.exe")

by Processes.action Processes.dest Processes.original_file_name Processes.parent_process Processes.parent_process_exec
   Processes.parent_process_guid Processes.parent_process_id Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_path
   Processes.process Processes.process_exec Processes.process_guid Processes.process_hash Processes.process_id
   Processes.process_integrity_level Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.user Processes.user_id
   Processes.vendor_product

| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval configuration_action=if(match(parent_process, "(?i)\s(configure|configuration|dsc)\s+(show|view|validate|list|ls|test)\b"), "preview", "apply")
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| `windows_winget_configuration_remoting_server_execution_filter`
